title: Public Alert No. 013/2026 – Alert on Dietary Supplement By FDA Over Safety Concerns
summary: NAFDAC alerts the public that Stuff by Nainax LLC is recalling all lots of MR.7 SUPER 700000 capsules, marketed online as a male-enhancement dietary supplement, after FDA analysis found undeclared sildenafil and tadalafil, which can dangerously lower blood pressure with nitrates.
